Latest News with the County
Election Ready? Here's What You Need to Know
Whether you're registering to vote, verifying your information, or looking for election deadlines, the Franklin County Clerk & Elections Office has the resources you need. Learn More...
Recycling Center Parking Lot Improvements Complete
New pavement and improved drainage make the parking lot shared by the Recycling Center and Noxious Weed Department cleaner, safer and easier to navigate in all kinds of weather. Read on...
Lunch on Us: Free Educational Series for Adults 60+
Upcoming sessions include: Making Medications Easier to Manage on Oct. 20 and Stay Active with ORC on Nov. 17. Learn More...
Official Primary Election Results
Official results from the August 4 Primary are now available. View Results...
Franklin County Awarded $1.8 Million in KDOT Funding for Indiana Road Bridge Replacement
Franklin County has been awarded approximately $1.8 million in KDOT funding to replace a bridge on Indiana Road south of Sand Creek. The County was one of only 16 recipients selected from more than 80 applications statewide. Read on...
